title: Clear-Line Frontier
description: Une esthétique de bande dessinée européenne définie par des contours noirs nets et uniformes (ligne claire) et des aplats de couleurs vibrantes. Elle contraste de vastes dégradés lisses avec un travail à l'encre hyper-détaillé sur les structures.
description_en: A European comic book aesthetic defined by crisp, uniform black outlines (ligne claire) and flat, vibrant color washes. It contrasts vast, smooth gradients with hyper-detailed, intricate ink linework on structures and terrain.
description_fr: Une esthétique de bande dessinée européenne définie par des contours noirs nets et uniformes (ligne claire) et des aplats de couleurs vibrantes. Elle contraste de vastes dégradés lisses avec un travail à l'encre hyper-détaillé sur les structures.
prompt: Bande dessinée comic art style, crisp ligne claire ink illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render with thin, uniform, unvarying black outlines that define every edge with absolute clarity. Incorporate highly detailed greebling, stippling, and fine ink hatching to establish texture and form on solid objects. Employ flat, vibrant color washes dominated by {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, punctuated by striking {{accent_color}} highlights. Environmental backdrops and skies must feature smooth, seamless airbrushed gradients that contrast heavily against the sharp, meticulous foreground ink work. Lighting remains mostly flat and ambient, utilizing hard-edged solid tone shadows and precise cross-hatched shading rather than soft volumetric illumination. The spatial dynamics suggest a retro-futuristic, expansive atmosphere, emphasizing vast scale, deep perspective, and intricate structural details. Surfaces appear matte with a subtle, clean comic-book finish. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. ligne claire, bande dessinée, comic book art, thin black outlines, flat color washes, detailed ink hatching, clear line contouring, retro-futuristic illustration, smooth gradients, crisp edges, meticulous detailing, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Subjects move with smooth, cel-animated fluidity, while mechanical or environmental elements shift with deliberate, rigid precision.
video.camera: Slow, sweeping pans that emphasize the vast scale and deep perspective of the landscapes.
video.temporal_texture: Ink outlines remain perfectly stable and uniform, while flat color fills and stippled shadows resist boiling or flickering.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, soft volumetric lighting shifts, 3D camera sweeps, and boiling lines that break the crisp comic aesthetic.
